item.title: Non-obvious Manipulability with Groups in Shapley-Scarf Housing Markets
item.description: This paper introduce NOM with groups, an incentive condition between strategy-proofness and non-obvious manipulability in which agents know only their own group's preferences, and characterize the housing-market mechanisms that satisfy it via a new family of TTC variants.

item.title: Incentivizing Participation of Compatible Pairs in Kidney Exchange Programs
item.description: This paper examines the effects of incentivizing compatible pairs to participate in kidney exchange programs. Submitted to Journal of Health Economics, 2025.
